mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 3% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when this trigger is met (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 4% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for three consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines persist for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise of at least 0.5 percentage points in UNRATE and a fall of at least 200,000 in PAYEMS within the same month signals a deterioration in labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp AND PAYEMS falls > 200000 in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of such joint-trigger months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly decline in both HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (personal savings) by more than 5% from the previous month indicates a sharp contraction in both housing demand and household liquidity, which reduces consumer spending and capital investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change < -5% AND RSAFS monthly change < -5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and CPIAUCSL (year-over-year inflation) exceeds 3%, the monetary policy is constrained by the zero lower bound, and persistent inflation erodes real purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: zero lower bound with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when both conditions hold for at least two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive relationship exists between real personal income growth (proxied by GDPC1 growth) and S&P 500 forward returns over a 60-day horizon, such that quarters with above-median GDPC1 growth are associated with positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No significant positive correlation between above-median GDPC1 growth quarters and positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns over a 10-year rolling window.
